props.text: Airbnb turnover clean or deep clean: what's the difference?
Most Manchester hosts need both. A turnover clean keeps the property guest-ready between stays, and a deep clean every so often stops dirt building up in the places a quick turnover can't reach.

props.cls: p-5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

props.text: A turnover clean happens between every guest. It gets the property ready quickly: the kitchen and bathrooms are cleaned, floors are vacuumed and mopped, beds are made with fresh linen, towels are put out and the rubbish is taken away. It follows our Airbnb turnover checklist and is planned around your check-out and check-in times.

props.cls: p-5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

props.text: A deep clean goes further and is best booked every few months, or before you list a property for the first time. It reaches the areas a turnover can't cover in the time between guests: inside appliances and cupboards, behind furniture, skirting boards, limescale and built-up grime. Read more about our [deep cleaning in Manchester](/service/deep-cleaning-manchester).

props.text: What Airbnb guests notice first, and how our Airbnb cleaning covers it

Airbnb guests make up their minds about a property within minutes of arriving, and that first impression often decides their Airbnb review. Our Airbnb cleaning in Manchester focuses on the five things guests notice first:

Airbnb guests check the shower, toilet and sink first. Hair, limescale or a dirty plughole is the most common reason for a low Airbnb cleanliness rating, so our Airbnb cleaners give the bathroom extra attention on every turnover.
Fresh, crease-free linen and plumped pillows tell Airbnb guests the property has been properly prepared. We change the linen and make every bed to the same neat standard.
Airbnb guests want to cook without cleaning first. Worktops, hob, microwave, sink and fridge are wiped, and crockery and cutlery are checked and put back in place.
Crumbs, dust and marks stand out in listing-style rooms. Floors are vacuumed and mopped, and surfaces, shelves and TV units are dusted.
A fresh-smelling property makes a great first impression. Bins are emptied, rubbish is taken away and the property is aired where possible, so your Airbnb feels fresh when guests walk in.

Beyond cleanliness, our turnover team also checks for unreported damage, missing inventory, and maintenance issues — giving you the information you need to protect your property and resolve any disputes with your hosting platform.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: Airbnb Cleaning Manchester

items.q: How quickly can you turn over an Airbnb property?
items.a: Most one and two-bedroom properties can be turned over within 2–3 hours between check-out and check-in. Larger properties are quoted individually. We work to your specific check-in time.

items.q: Do you provide linen and towels?
items.a: We can launder linen and towels on-site if your property has a washing machine and dryer. We can also coordinate with a linen service if you require off-site laundering.
Yes. We work with Manchester Airbnb hosts managing single properties and large portfolios alike. We can coordinate across multiple properties and integrate with your Airbnb calendar.

items.q: What happens if a guest causes damage?
items.a: Our team photographs and logs any damage discovered during the turnover and notifies you immediately — giving you documentation to support a claim with Airbnb or your insurer.

items.q: Do you cover all Manchester Airbnb areas?
items.a: Yes. We cover all Greater Manchester postcodes including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Chorlton, Fallowfield, Stretford, and surrounding areas.

items.q: What is included in an Airbnb turnover clean?
items.a: Every turnover covers the kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas and hallways: surfaces wiped, floors vacuumed and mopped, bathrooms cleaned, beds made with fresh linen, towels folded and bins emptied. The full Airbnb turnover cleaning checklist is on this page.

items.q: How much does Airbnb cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: The price depends on the size of your property and what it needs. Book online to see your price before you pay, or contact us for a free quote if you manage several properties.

items.q: Do I need to be at the property during the clean?
items.a: No. Just tell us how our cleaner can get in, for example a key safe or smart lock code, when you book.
Yes. Every Cleaniq Services cleaner is vetted and background checked before their first job.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the clean?
items.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.

items.q: Do you clean holiday lets and serviced apartments too?
items.a: Yes. Our short-let cleaning covers Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo listings, holiday lets and serviced apartments across Greater Manchester.

items.q: Can I add a deep clean or carpet cleaning to my Airbnb clean?
items.a: Yes. Add a deep clean, oven cleaning or carpet cleaning when your property needs more than a turnover. Book online or ask us when you call.

items.q: Can you clean on the same day as check-out and check-in?
items.a: Yes. Tell us your guests' check-out and check-in times when you book and we'll plan the clean to fit between them. Book early for busy weekends and event days in Manchester.

items.q: How often should I deep clean my Airbnb?
items.a: Most hosts book a deep clean every few months, depending on how busy the property is. A deep clean reaches the areas a turnover clean can't cover between guests, such as inside appliances and cupboards and behind furniture.

items.q: Can you clean my property before I list it on Airbnb?
items.a: Yes. Book a deep clean before your first guest arrives, so your property starts spotless and your listing photos show it at its best.

items.q: Can my Airbnb co-host or property manager book the cleaning?
items.a: Yes. Anyone who looks after your Airbnb can book Airbnb cleaning with us online or by phone. Just make sure they share the check-out time, check-in time and access details for the property.

items.q: Do you clean Airbnb properties after a long stay?
items.a: Yes. After a long Airbnb stay, a standard turnover may not be enough. Book a deep clean to reset the property before your next Airbnb guest arrives.
